info.name: Fishcart Seafood Commerce API
info.description: Current Django REST API collection for customer email OTP, customer JWT, and staff session workflows. Order status values: confirmed, out_for_delivery, completed, cancelled. Delivery uses server-calculated straight-line distance. Set baseUrl, configure a mailbox and staff credentials, then run requests in the documented order. Postman retains cookies; never export or share a collection after authentication.

item.description: Reason codes: out_of_stock, delivery_unavailable, operational_issue, customer_request. The saved message appears in customer order history.
